~ The leader of this bunch of vampire hunters.  He seeks nothing less than
the total extermination of all vampires.

identity:
I can't believe magic is fucking real.  They seconded me to Offworld Acquisitions because despite months of trying they still hadn't managed to crack any of the encryption used by the Dahab on 089AA, so I went along with them on the latest dive.  They also sent along one of those Mobile Task Force people from, well, she said she was from "Middle-Management", whatever that means.  I didn't think too much of it until the local authorities found us out and jumped us in the middle of our exfiltration.  We were pinned down, banging our heads together trying to figure out a way out before the real firepower showed up when that lady just started chanting.  Chanting!  I thought she had lost it until these *things* just appeared out of nowhere and started ripping the cops apart.  Once the screams stopped, we ran for the dive point.

I didn't have time to ask "manager" what the hell had happened, they all took us to separate rooms to gently inquire as to why everything had gone to shit.  When I asked them what had happened they just told me I'm not cleared for that information.  I'm cleared to visit alternate realities but not know what the hell my teammates can do?  Is this how OA is run?

I know I'm a psychic and acting like Rodriguez was a witch summoning demons or whatever the hell those things are is hypocritical, but I swear that's what it was like.  She was chanting in something that wasn't English, wasn't Spanish, wasn't any language I know, and her demons weren't all there.  Every time I so much as moved my eyes they just kept shifting position, and it wasn't a trick because the Dahab cops couldn't land a shot on them.  Their teeth still bit, though.

Red, if you get an offer to go with OA, don't do it.
-Mhairi

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of mutation 'Senseless and Without Knowledge'
